sloka: उवाच देवदेवेशं वरदं प्रपितामहम् ।देवानां भयसंमोहो लोकानां सङ्क्षयं प्रति ।। ७.६९.२२ ॥
transliteration: uvāca devadeveśaṁ varadaṁ prapitāmaham ।devānāṁ bhayasaṁmoho lokānāṁ saṅkṣayaṁ prati ।। 7.69.22 ॥

translations.english: The gods addressed Brahma, the great-grandfather and bestower of boons, regarding the fear and bewilderment among the gods and the impending destruction of the worlds.
